before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path = '/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(path)
totals = df.groupby('診療科')['患者数'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
colors = ['#d62728' if dept == '内科' else '#8aa6c1' for dept in totals.index]
bars = ax.bar(totals.index, totals.values, color=colors)
ax.set_title('診療科ごとの患者数合計')
ax.set_xlabel('診療科')
ax.set_ylabel('患者数（人）')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(totals.values) * 1.12)
ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
